request.query: At what time is the Pier 7 tide gate inspected at Cobalt Harbor?

body.query: At what time is the Pier 7 tide gate inspected at Cobalt Harbor?

results.content:
Cobalt        Harbor          Operations             Manual                                                                                                             

                 Source  page  1  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 Cobalt   Harbor    is a  fictional  coastal   logistics  site  used   for  the  North   Basin   exercise.    Pier                                                                              
                 7 handles    the  blue-crate     route,  and   its tide gate   is inspected     at 06:40   every    morning.                                                                                   
                 The   gate  uses   a  six-bolt  brass   latch   and  is never    opened     during   a red-current     warning.                                                                                
                 The   harbor   office  records    the  inspection    in ledger    H-17.   The   blue-crate    route   is                                                                                       
                 separate    from   the  amber-crate      route,  which    uses   Pier  3.                                                                                                                      

                                                  DOCSEARCH-08     project-owned  benchmark  |  page 1

Cobalt        Harbor          Operations             Manual                                                                                                             

                 Source  page  3  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 During   the  North   Basin    exercise,    the  emergency      beacon     is mounted     beside    Pier  3,  not                                                                              
                 Pier  7. It flashes   violet  for a  radio  failure  and   white   for a  power    failure. The                                                                                                
                 maintenance       team   tests  the  beacon     on  Thursdays      at 14:20.   Beacon     checks     are                                                                                       
                 recorded    in ledger    M-3   and  are   unrelated    to the  tide-gate    inspection    in ledger   H-17.                                                                                    

                                                  DOCSEARCH-08     project-owned  benchmark  |  page 3

Cobalt        Harbor          Operations             Manual                                                                                                             

                 Source  page  2  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 The   Cobalt   Harbor    night  shift  begins   at  22:15   and   ends   at  05:45.   Night   supervisors                                                                                      
                 carry  a  copper    badge    marked     N-4.  A  night-shift   report  must    list  the  weather   vane                                                                                       
                 reading,   the  number     of  sealed   containers,     and   any  red-current     warning.    The   harbor                                                                                    
                 office  records   night-shift   reports   in  ledger   N-22   and   does   not  accept    unsigned     reports,                                                                                
                 even   when    no  cargo   moved.                                                                                                                                                              

                                                  DOCSEARCH-08     project-owned  benchmark  |  page 2

Paper        Bridge         Archive         Protocol                                                                                                                 

                 Source  page  3  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 The   archive's   stone   vault   has  three   aisles.  Aisle   C  stores   maps,    Aisle  F  stores   field                                                                                  
                 journals,   and   Aisle  R  stores   repair  records.    The   weekly    vault  inspection     occurs   on                                                                                     
                 Monday     at 09:30.    A vault   inspection    checks    the  aisle  seal  and   humidity    card;   it  does                                                                                 
                 not  recalculate    the  Q-17   checksum.                                                                                                                                                      

                                                  DOCSEARCH-08     project-owned  benchmark  |  page 3

Willow        Grid      Maintenance                Handbook                                                                                                               

                 Source  page  1  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 The   fictional  Willow   Grid   supplies   power    to  three  research     districts.  The   amber    inverter                                                                               
                 in District  North   is inspected     every   14  days,   and   its replacement      fuse  is rated   at 32                                                                                    
                 amperes.     The   inverter   cabinet   carries   a  diamond-shaped         amber    label.  District  North   is                                                                              
                 the  only  district using   the  32-ampere       fuse  in this  handbook.                                                                                                                      

                                                  DOCSEARCH-08     project-owned  benchmark  |  page 1

request.query: What is the orbital period of the Lumen-3 satellite?

body.query: What is the orbital period of the Lumen-3 satellite?

results.content:
Lumen          Orbit       Mission          Briefing                                                                                                                

                 Source  page  1  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 The   fictional  Lumen-3     satellite  follows   a  polar  orbit  with  an  orbital  period   of  97  minutes.                                                                                
                 Its primary   instrument     is the  dusk   spectrometer,       which   measures      the  blue   edge   of a                                                                                  
                 planet's   reflected   light. Lumen-3      stores   one   orbit of  raw  data   in a  64-gigabyte     ring                                                                                     
                 buffer  before   transmitting     a compressed       packet    to the  Aurora    relay.                                                                                                        

                                                  DOCSEARCH-08     project-owned  benchmark  |  page 1

Lumen          Orbit       Mission          Briefing

                 relay  antenna     points  18   degrees    east   during   the  first half of  the  window    and   18

Lumen          Orbit       Mission          Briefing                                                                                                                

                 Source  page  1  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 The   fictional  Lumen-3     satellite  follows   a  polar  orbit  with  an  orbital  period   of  97  minutes.                                                                                
                 Its primary   instrument     is the  dusk   spectrometer,       which   measures      the  blue   edge   of a                                                                                  
                 planet's   reflected   light. Lumen-3      stores   one   orbit of  raw  data   in a  64-gigabyte     ring                                                                                     
                 buffer  before   transmitting     a compressed       packet    to the  Aurora    relay.

Lumen          Orbit       Mission          Briefing                                                                                                                

                 Source  page  2  |  DocSearch  AI benchmark    team                                                                                                                                            

                 The   Aurora   relay   receives    Lumen-3     packets     during   a 12-minute     contact    window.     The                                                                                 
                 relay  antenna     points  18   degrees    east   during   the  first half of  the  window    and   18                                                                                         
                 degrees    west   during   the  second     half. The   mission    uses    a silver  timing   pulse   to mark                                                                                   
                 the  handoff.   A  packet    not  carrying   the  pulse   is held   for review    instead   of being                                                                                           
                 discarded.

                 The   fictional  Solace    probe   is a  separate    mission.    Solace    maps    the  dark   side  of the                                                                                    
                 moon    Nera   with  a  thermal    camera     and  completes      a scan    in 41  minutes.    Unlike                                                                                          
                 Lumen-3,     Solace    does   not  use   a  polar  orbit  or the  Aurora    relay.  The   two   mission                                                                                        
                 names    appear     together   in  status  summaries       but  their  instruments     and   schedules     must
